correctness.rationale: Getzler's inversion formula and the exact open-moduli Euler characteristic give f(x)=2x-(1+x)log(1+x). Differentiating its inverse yields h'=x+2h+hh' and hence an exact integral recurrence. A complete mod-four induction separates even and odd recurrence indices; Lucas parity controls the even-row convolution and the exact even-index binomial sum controls the odd row. This proves the three residue classes and exact two-adic valuation. The package checker independently verifies the recurrence and formal composition with rational arithmetic.

value.rationale: The Deligne--Mumford spaces Mbar_0,n are fundamental moduli spaces, and their Euler characteristics encode the total size of their even cohomology. The theorem gives a complete and unexpectedly rigid two-primary classification across the entire tower: odd exactly at odd n, exactly twice odd at even n, and never divisible by four. The mod-four cycle is a structural invariant extracted uniformly from the classical inversion equation, not a finite congruence experiment.
